Selab is also a common name for water, which in Islamic traditions symbolizes life and purity, further emphasizing the calming and refreshing qualities of the name.

The name reminds us to seek tranquility in our hearts and minds, even in the midst of chaos and turmoil. It serves as a reminder to prioritize mental and emotional wellbeing, which is essential for cultivating a strong spiritual connection with Allah. Selab is also a reminder of the peaceful and refreshing qualities of water in the natural world, which is often used as a metaphor for Allah's divine mercy and gentle guidance in our lives.
